name: Barbell Seated Overhead Triceps Extension
steps: Sit tall on a bench with feet planted firmly and press a barbell straight overhead using a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Brace your core tightly and tuck your upper arms close alongside your ears.
Bend your elbows slowly to lower the bar behind your head until you feel a deep stretch in your triceps.
Extend your elbows forcefully to return the bar overhead while keeping your upper arms stationary.
tips: Keep your elbows pointed upward rather than letting them flare far out to the sides.
Keep your rib cage down so your lower back does not arch as the bar drops behind your head.
